entities.summary: Enrico dal Covolo SDB is a Catholic bishop and Italian theologian, the Assessor of the Pontifical Committee for Historical Sciences since 15 January 2019. He previously served as the rector of the Pontifical Lateran University from 30 June 2010 to 2 June 2018. He was also the postulator of the cause of canonization of Pope John Paul I from 2003 until 2016.
